english.legislation: Contrary to section 111(1)(b) and (3) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
subject to the provisions of Chapter III of Part IV of the Water Industry Act 1991
threw, emptied or turned into a public sewer or into a drain or sewer communicating with a public sewer
chemical refuse or waste steam or such liquid of a temperature of higher than forty-three degrees celsius
as, by virtue of section 111(2) of the Act is a prohibited substance

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum and to a further fine not exceeding £50 for each day on which the offence continues after conviction - see section 111(4) of the Act
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

libra.complexpenaltydetails: On summary conviction, a further fine of £50 for each day on which the offence continues after conviction may be imposed - see section 111(4) of the Act for details
